title: Mitral stenosis opening snap occurs when mitral valve opens (start filling)

properties.Correct answer: Point D (mitral valve opens; start of diastolic filling)
properties.Stem (brief): 34-year-old with opening snap + rumbling diastolic murmur at apex (mitral stenosis). Where on LV pressure–volume loop does the snap occur?
properties.Takeaway (1 sentence): Mitral stenosis = opening snap at mitral valve opening (point D) + rumbling diastolic murmur at apex.
properties.One-liner (Key concept): Mitral stenosis opening snap occurs when mitral valve opens (start filling)
